jobs_results.job_title: Data Analyst | 2- 3 Yrs | Media /Advertisement  Domain | Remote
jobs_results.description:
THE ROLE
Were looking for a Senior Analyst who can own the reporting layer for a set of client accounts — building, maintaining, and evolving dashboards and performance reports that translate media data into actionable intelligence. You’re fluent in SQL, comfortable in a modern BI/dashboarding tool, and have firsthand experience working with the messy, multi-platform reality of paid media data.
This is a client-facing role, which means you’ll be on calls, in meetings, and occasionally explaining methodology to people who care deeply about the numbers. You’ll work closely with analytics leads, media strategists, and platform specialists to make sure the reporting picture is accurate, complete, and useful.


WHAT YOU’LL DO
Reporting & Visualization

Build and maintain client-facing dashboards in our BI/dashboarding environment, translating multi-platform media data into clean, navigable performance views
Own the reporting cadence for assigned accounts: weekly pacing reports, monthly performance summaries, and ad hoc analyses as needed
Design reporting frameworks that scale — not one-off builds that only you can maintain
Document data logic, calculated fields, and methodology so outputs are auditable and explainable

Data Engineering & Pipeline Work

Be comfortable with adjusting SQL queries and using natural language LLM inqueries against our cloud data warehouse to pull, clean, and structure media performance data for reporting
Contribute to the ongoing work of streamlining and centralizing our reporting pipelines
Partner with our teams to use AI and Python for data transformation, automation, or light analytical tasks where SQL alone isn’t the right tool
QA your own work and flag data integrity issues proactively — you’re a first line of defense before numbers reach clients

Media Data & Platform Fluency

Work directly with data from major ad platforms across paid social, paid search, programmatic, and emerging channels
Understand the measurement nuances of paid media data — attribution windows, modeled vs. observed conversions, platform discrepancies
Collaborate with activation and strategy teams to ensure reporting reflects actual media executions accurately
Stay current on platform reporting changes (API updates, measurement shifts, new ad types) and adjust accordingly

Client Engagement

Participate in client calls and reporting presentations, fielding questions about data sources, methodology, and performance trends
Translate technical data issues into plain-language explanations for non-technical stakeholders
Identify patterns in performance data worth flagging or investigating, not just reporting what’s already obvious

WHAT YOU BRING
Required

2–3 years of experience in a data, analytics, or reporting role, ideally at a media agency, ad tech company, or in-house media team
Proficiency in a modern BI/dashboarding tool: you can build production-quality dashboards from scratch, not just modify existing templates
Strong SQL skills: comfortable with joins, aggregations, window functions, and debugging queries against large tables
Hands-on experience with paid media data from at least two major advertising platforms (across paid social, paid search, programmatic, or similar)
Working knowledge of Python for data wrangling, automation, or analysis
Understanding of core media metrics and how they are measured differently across platforms (impressions, CPM, ROAS, CPA, viewability, etc.)
Strong attention to detail and a compulsion to QA your own work before it goes out the door
Comfortable communicating directly with clients and explaining data clearly

Preferred

Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse
Familiarity with Alteryx, dbt, or similar data prep or transformation tools
Exposure to attribution and measurement platforms (e.g., Northbeam, Triple Whale, Measured, Nielsen)
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau
Comfort using AI coding tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate SQL writing, debugging, or Python work

WHAT TO EXPECT
You’ll join a small, high-accountability team where the work is visible and the feedback is direct. Our clients are engaged and expect accuracy — which means the reporting layer you own actually matters. You’ll have room to grow: as our capabilities expand and we standardize how reporting is delivered, there are real opportunities to take on more ownership, more complexity, and more client exposure over time.

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst – Consultant/Senior Consultant to build governed data products and analyses that support achievement of brand goals across multiple therapeutic areas, while continuously driving process improvement, innovation, and adoption of agentic AI ways of working.

Job Responsibilities



Design, build, and maintain governed data objects (tables, materialized views, metric views) within Unity Catalog and the enterprise semantic layer, supporting a range of commercial analytics use cases across multiple therapeutic areas.Design and define key KPIs and metrics for brand and commercial stakeholders using HCP prescribing behaviour, activity, patient journey, and claims-based datasets, exercising sound judgment when data is incomplete or ambiguous.Support the team's agentic AI initiatives by contributing to feedback triage and quality checks that keep AI-driven tools aligned with the governed data layer.Participate across the full project lifecycle, including kick-off, methodology development, execution, insight generation, and results presentation, while developing into a trusted advisor to stakeholders.Collaborate across teams (data engineering, data science, functional product, BI) to resolve dependencies/open issues, prioritize backlog items and identify technical debt and legacy dependencies and design governed, reusable alternatives.Prepare clear analytical summaries and documentation, and communicate final outputs and recommendations directly to stakeholders.Translate ambiguous or loosely-defined business requirements into technical specifications and user stories within an Agile delivery framework.Continuously leverage AI/agentic tools to automate documentation, code review, and repetitive tasks, driving team efficiency.Own data quality and validation for assigned data assets, validating outputs against production baselines and maintaining documentation, lineage, and version control.Investigate and root-cause data discrepancies distinguishing genuine defects from issues owned elsewhere, and propose fixes.


Job Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.4+ years of experience carrying out the required responsibilities in pharma commercial/HCP analytics, claims-based analytics, or analytics in other industries.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous or loosely-defined business questions into structured solutions.Working knowledge of Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake) and advanced SQL for building and reviewing large-scale data objects; familiarity with PySpark or Python or SAS is a plus.Working knowledge of pharma claims data sources and U.S. HCP/patient-level analytics concepts is a plus.Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical/data concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.Exposure to or strong interest in agentic AI/LLM-assisted engineering workflows that accelerate documentation, testing, and code review, paired with working knowledge of CI/CD concepts for data pipelines, including version control and environment promotion across development, test, and production.Experience with Agile delivery practices (epics, stories, sprint planning) in a data product environment is preferred.Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, using sound judgment to prioritize and resolve issues with incomplete information; strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.Traditional BI tool experience (Power BI, Tableau) is a plus, as is exposure to building lightweight analytical front ends using frameworks such as Flask or Streamlit.
